title: Join a flat
intro: Enter the invite code that a member of your flat shared with you.

notFound.title: We could not find a flat with this invite code.
notFound.hint: Check the code for typos, or ask a member of the flat for a new one.

expired.title: This invite code has expired.
expired.hint: Ask an admin of the flat for a new invite code.

throttled.title: Too many attempts in a short time.
throttled.hint: Wait a few minutes, then try again.

generic.title: We could not join the flat.
generic.hint: Check your connection and try again.
